text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, not more typing.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, searchable, and actually completed. Forecast reviews stopped relying on memory.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated. Asking upfront, and explaining how recordings are used, built trust instead of eroding it.

**4. In-person is harder.** Noisy sites and side conversations hurt accuracy. Reps still needed a quick review.

**5. Coaching improved.** Managers spotted patterns in objections and shared them across the team.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It removed the busywork around it.

What has your team learned from AI in the field?
